parameters.name: apprise_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`Apprise connection id <howto/connection:apprise>` that has services configured in the `config` field.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Specify the message title. This field is complete optional

parameters.name: notify_type
parameters.description: Specify the message type (default=info). Possible values are "info", "success", "failure", and "warning"

parameters.name: body_format
parameters.description: Specify the input message format (default=text). Possible values are "text", "html", and "markdown".

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Specify one or more tags to filter which services to notify

parameters.name: attach
parameters.description: Specify one or more file attachment locations

parameters.name: interpret_escapes
parameters.description: Enable interpretation of backslash escapes. For example, this would convert sequences such as \n and \r to their respected ascii new-line and carriage

parameters.name: apprise_conn_id
parameters.description: connection that has Apprise configs setup
